title: Inducing Political Bias Allows Language Models Anticipate Partisan Reactions to Controversies
findings: In the context of the abortion debate, the finetuned model showed a less precise alignment with real-world data compared to the pretrained model on the specific topic of 'Religion' for some metrics, particularly for emotion detection. The paper suggests this may indicate the inherent complexity of the issue, where the pretrained model's broader, less targeted understanding of emotional expression sometimes more closely mirrored real-world responses.
